description: Public edition: A supervisory platform coordinating knowledge, computation, scientific research, manufacturing, and infrastructure.
body:
Civilization-Scale Intelligence Operating System. A supervisory platform coordinating knowledge, computation, scientific research, manufacturing, and infrastructure.

This database covers the technology as item 211 entry 40 of Manon's "100 Ultra-Advanced Future Technologies" catalog, section "Intelligence Beyond Today's AI". It is the public edition: every factual claim below is drawn from real public science and engineering, honestly labeled.

Feasibility tier: theoretically plausible. Supervisory control systems coordinate grids and factories; civilization-scale coordination is unproven and raises governance questions.

Classification: public database. This record profiles the technology; companion records cover known science, constraints, approaches, tools, unresolved problems, evidence, and outlook.

title: Civilization-Scale Intelligence Operating System - Known Science Foundations
description: Public edition: A supervisory platform coordinating knowledge, computation, scientific research, manufacturing, and infrastructure.
body:
Known science foundations of Civilization-Scale Intelligence Operating System.

SCADA systems supervise power grids; MES coordinates factories; cloud orchestrators manage planetary compute. Smart-city platforms integrate transport and utilities. A single supervisory platform spanning knowledge, research, manufacturing, and infrastructure exists only as concept — and centralization carries failure-mode and governance risks.

Key quantity check (Devices under management in largest IoT platforms / humans in a civilization): computed ratio 1.875 against the reference value, relative error 0, within the stated tolerance of 0.3. This calculation was executed in Node.js at build time and the output stored verbatim.

Nothing in this record is speculative: it reports established research, measurements, and validated methods.

title: Civilization-Scale Intelligence Operating System - Physical and Engineering Constraints
description: Public edition: A supervisory platform coordinating knowledge, computation, scientific research, manufacturing, and infrastructure.
body:
Physical and engineering constraints on Civilization-Scale Intelligence Operating System.

Centralized supervision creates single points of failure. Heterogeneous domains resist unified control. Who governs the governor is unsolved.

Scale analysis across 3 quantities spans 10.18 orders of magnitude; the dominant scale separation is managed devices vs supervisory latency at 10.18 orders of magnitude (managed devices larger). Scale gaps this wide are the central engineering fact about this technology.

body:
Unresolved problems for Civilization-Scale Intelligence Operating System, in priority order (research burden index 30, 2 blocking):

Avoiding catastrophic centralization (severity 3/3, tractability 1/3, BLOCKING; priority 12).

Cross-domain semantic interop (severity 3/3, tractability 2/3, BLOCKING; priority 9).

Legitimate governance (severity 3/3, tractability 1/3; priority 9).

These are open problems, stated plainly. A technology with unresolved blocking problems is not ready, whatever its promise.
